sourceTitle: Transglycosidases from Aspergillus genus and their applications in food processing: Advances in enzyme mining and smart biocatalysis.
sourceAbstract: Transglycosidases (TGs) constitute a family of glycoside hydrolases that perform glycosyl transfer via intra- and intermolecular substitution. A. niger, A. oryzae, and other Aspergillus strains represent the major industrial sources of TGs, which are widely applied in food processing. However, prominent bottlenecks still restrict the optimization of enzyme performance, industrial adaptation, and the construction of synergistic catalytic systems. This comprehensive review expounds the application potential of Aspergillus-derived TGs in food processing, analyzes the scientific basis of artificial intelligence (AI) regulation on enzyme catalytic performance, systematically summarizes the molecular modification and multi-enzyme synergistic mechanisms, and illustrates their application effects in the fields of prebiotic oligosaccharides, dairy products, brewing, and baking. Furthermore, it promotes the in-depth integration of AI and food biomanufacturing, and advances the high-quality development of the green functional food processing industry, showing sustainable and bright prospects in smart bioprocessing and big-health food research.
titleZh: 曲霉属来源的转糖苷酶及其在食品加工中的应用：酶挖掘与智能生物催化研究进展
abstractZh: 转糖苷酶（TGs）属于糖苷水解酶家族，可通过分子内或分子间取代完成糖基转移。黑曲霉、米曲霉及其他曲霉菌株是工业转糖苷酶的主要来源，这类酶广泛应用于食品加工。不过，酶性能优化、工业适应及协同催化体系构建仍受到明显瓶颈制约。本综述阐述曲霉来源转糖苷酶在食品加工中的应用潜力，分析利用人工智能调控酶催化性能的科学依据，系统总结分子改造和多酶协同机制，并介绍其在益生元低聚糖、乳制品、酿造和烘焙等领域的应用效果。文章进一步讨论人工智能与食品生物制造的融合，以及绿色功能食品加工、智能生物加工和大健康食品研究的发展前景。

sourceTitle: Development of isopentenol utilization pathway based on cell-free metabolic engineering and its application in multienzyme cascades synthesis.
sourceAbstract: Conventional microbial biosynthetic pathways for isoprenoid often require intricate metabolic balancing and multigene regulation, which are not only time-consuming but also prone to interference from host cellular metabolism and feedback inhibition by toxic intermediate metabolites or end-products. In this study, we developed a novel cell-free multienzyme catalytic system for the synthesis of lycopene, a representative isoprenoid. By integrating the isopentenol utilization pathway with cell-free metabolic engineering strategies, the system eliminates the need for complex in vivo genetic modifications and avoids inherent cellular metabolic interference. The in vitro reaction employs seven enzymes directly, enabling rapid and efficient lycopene production without relying on costly substrates isopentenyl pyrophosphate (IPP) and dimethylallyl pyrophosphate (DMAPP). The optimized cell-free reaction mixture consisted of isoprenol and prenol (3:1 molar ratio, 15 mM), seven key enzymes (each at a concentration of 0.6 mg/mL), 8 mM Mg 2 + , 1 mM NAD, 1 mM ATP, 1 mM CoA, and 0.05% (w/v) Tween 20 in 30 mM Bis-Tris buffer (pH 6.5). After incubation at 30 °C for 20 h, the lycopene titer reached 128.04 mg/L. Further in vivo validation achieved a final lycopene titer of 270.0 mg/L. This novel approach offers a promising alternative strategy to overcome common challenges associated with the construction and regulation of complex natural isoprenoid biosynthetic pathways.
titleZh: 基于无细胞代谢工程构建异戊烯醇利用途径及其在多酶级联合成中的应用
abstractZh: 类异戊二烯化合物的常规微生物生物合成途径通常需要复杂的代谢平衡和多基因调控，这不仅耗时，还容易受到宿主细胞代谢的干扰，以及有毒代谢中间体或终产物的反馈抑制。本研究开发了一种新型无细胞多酶催化体系，用于合成具有代表性的类异戊二烯化合物番茄红素。通过将异戊烯醇利用途径与无细胞代谢工程策略相结合，该体系无需复杂的体内遗传改造，并避免了细胞固有代谢的干扰。体外反应直接使用7种酶，无需依赖昂贵的底物异戊烯基焦磷酸（IPP）和二甲基烯丙基焦磷酸（DMAPP），即可实现番茄红素的快速、高效生产。优化后的无细胞反应混合物包含isoprenol和prenol（摩尔比3:1，15 mM）、7种关键酶（各自浓度为0.6 mg/mL）、8 mM Mg²⁺、1 mM NAD、1 mM ATP、1 mM CoA以及0.05%（w/v）Tween 20，以30 mM Bis-Tris缓冲液（pH 6.5）为反应介质。在30 °C下孵育20 h后，番茄红素滴度达到128.04 mg/L。进一步的体内验证获得了270.0 mg/L的最终番茄红素滴度。这一新方法为克服复杂天然类异戊二烯生物合成途径构建和调控中的常见难题，提供了有前景的替代策略。
